## KeyOf type

Key type inferred from a schema class.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type KeyOf<S extends typeof LmdbSchema> = IInferSchemaKey<S[`key`]> & ILmdbKey;
```
**References:** [LmdbSchema](./lmdb.lmdbschema.md)<!-- -->, [IInferSchemaKey](./lmdb.iinferschemakey.md)<!-- -->, [ILmdbKey](./lmdb.ilmdbkey.md)

## Remarks

Short alias for `IInferSchemaKey<typeof X.key> & ILmdbKey` — the key value type intersected with `ILmdbKey`<!-- -->, mirroring the runtime [LmdbEnv.register()](./lmdb.lmdbenv.register.md) overload (lmdb-js keys are `Key[] | string | symbol | number | boolean | Uint8Array`<!-- -->), so a `t.bigint()` key column degrades to `never` at the type level:

```typescript
type UserKey = KeyOf<typeof UserSchema>
```
